summary: Frontend-only e2e verification of Blade -> Inertia+Vue 3 conversion on https://laravel-refresh-1.preview.emergentagent.com. All converted routes render as Vue (data-v-app present, no Inertia 404, no pageerrors). Public: /, /browse/auctions, /browse/live, /browse/explore, /contact, /corporate (Hakkımızda), /privacy-policy all 200 OK. Home client-side search filters card count (24 -> 12 for 'vintage'); the 4 sort buttons (Popüler / Bitmek Üzere / Yeni / Fiyat) are present and clickable. Auth: /login, /register (3-step wizard), /forgot-password render with hero right panel; register buyer-role -> Adım 2/2 (password step), seller-role -> Adım 2/3 (Satıcı Doğrulama: company/tax/IBAN/id document) -> continues to password step. Login flow: buyer@test.com/password redirects to /dashboard (Inertia Vue, title 'Panelim', shows role-based sidebar HESABIM section, header search/theme/notif/logout/balance testids all present); seller@test.com/password authenticates successfully (SATICI PANELİ sidebar visible). Authenticated Inertia pages verified: /dashboard, /my-bids, /favorites, /orders, /notifications, /support, /support/create — all vueRoot=1, no pageerrors, no console errors (except pre-existing 403 image noise). Theme toggle (data-testid=theme-toggle) flips html[data-bs-theme] dark<->light and persists across SPA navigation. Support create validation: empty submit shows inline pf-error messages ('subject/category/body alanı zorunludur') on the correct fields; filling valid data (subject + category + priority + body>10) creates ticket and SPA-navigates to /support/{id}.

integration_issues.issue: Review request expected redirect to /support (list) with a success flash after ticket creation. Actual behaviour redirects directly to /support/{id} (the new ticket detail page). No visible flash/toast on that page. Minor UX deviation — not blocking.

issues: ~40 console 403 errors per navigation for seed image URLs (image-fallback.js swaps placeholder correctly). Pre-existing from iteration 1 / 2 — not a conversion regression.

detailed_results.note_review_request_typos: Review request listed '/corporta' and '/gizlilik-politikasi' — actual Ziggy routes are 'corporate' -> /corporate and 'privacy' -> /privacy-policy. Both work correctly; the request text just had wrong paths.

register_wizard.buyer_role_step2: Adım 2 / 2 — password + password-confirm + terms + Kayıt Ol
register_wizard.seller_role_step2: Adım 2 / 3 — Satıcı Doğrulama (Şirket Adı opsiyonel, Vergi Numarası, IBAN, Kimlik Belgesi file input)

authenticated_pages./notifications: ok — 'Henüz bildiriminiz yok' (notif-read-all button hidden because 0 notifications, expected)
authenticated_pages./support: ok — FAQ accordions + 'Henüz destek talebiniz yok'

support_validation.valid_submit_result: redirected to /support/1 (new ticket show), title 'Talep #1', conversation shows submitted body

action_items: Fix review-request path typos in future task docs: use /corporate (not /corporta) and /privacy-policy (not /gizlilik-politikasi). Routes/pages themselves work fine.

(Optional) After support ticket creation, redirect to /support (list) with flash 'Talep oluşturuldu' instead of jumping directly to /support/{id} — matches the behaviour described in the review request. Current behaviour is arguably better UX; either is acceptable.
critical_code_review_comments: Inertia + Vue mount is clean: every converted page has exactly one [data-v-app] root, no duplicated app boots, no leftover data-page attribute after hydration.

AppLayout correctly renders role-based sidebar: buyer sees HESABIM section (Dashboard/Tekliflerim/Siparişlerim/Favoriler/Bildirimler/Destek), seller sees SATICI PANELİ (Panel/İlanlarım/Canlı Yayın/Satışlarım/Destek).
Theme toggle uses localStorage['theme'] preload script in <head> so no FOUC on navigation — good.
Support form uses .pf-error inline error rendering (per-field) driven by Inertia validation payload — matches original Blade behaviour.

success_rate.frontend: 98% (all critical Inertia conversion scenarios pass; one minor UX deviation on support redirect)

test_credentials: buyer@test.com / password, seller@test.com / password (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md) — both verified this run
seed_data_creation: Created 1 support ticket #1 as buyer@test.com (subject 'TEST konu başlığı', body 'Bu bir test açıklamasıdır. Karakter sayısı yeterli.') — safe TEST_ prefix in body could be added on future runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Blade->Inertia+Vue conversion is functionally green. Key testids used: login-email/-password/-submit, register-name/-username/-email/-phone/-step1-next/-password/-password-confirm/-terms, index-search-input, theme-toggle, header-search-input/-notif-toggle/-logout, sidebar-messages/-buyer-orders, support-subject/-category/-priority/-body/-submit. Ziggy route names: corporate -> /corporate, privacy -> /privacy-policy (review request had typos). Buyer dashboard renders 'Panelim' with 5 AKTİF TEKLİF / 2 FAVORİ badges from seed data. New support ticket #1 was created during this run.
rca of the issue: n/a — no bugs blocking. Only a minor UX deviation on support-create redirect (goes to /support/{id} instead of /support+flash).
